clips.title: The story
paras: In Loch Modan, crocolisk skins come from the fierce beasts that haunt the Loch’s islands and waters. Merchants and leatherworkers seek their durable hides, though hunters face danger to gather them.

Crocolisks crowd the Loch’s cold waters and make dens along its islands and shores. Their sharp teeth and thick scales make them dangerous quarry. Hunters based at Farstrider Lodge still pursue them for their hides. Tailors, leatherworkers, and merchants from distant places seek the skins for sturdy garments and armor, so undamaged hides bring a good price in the region.
